title: FluxMenu
body:
# FluxMenu

Smooth animated main menu experience for Minecraft.

FluxMenu redesigns the vanilla main menu with fluid animations, modern transitions, and a polished client-like interface while keeping the original Minecraft style clean and lightweight.

## ✨ Features

- Smooth button hover animations
- Modern menu transitions
- Clean and responsive UI
- Lightweight and optimized
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Client-style visual polish

FluxMenu focuses on making menu navigation feel alive, fluid, and satisfying without changing the core Minecraft experience.

## 📦 Dependency

FluxMenu requires:
- [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
- [EnvironmentDetector (API)](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmentdetector-api)

## 🔧 Compatibility

- Fabric
- Client-side only

## 🌌 Designed For

Players who want:
- a cleaner main menu
- smooth UI animations
- a more modern Minecraft experience
- lightweight visual improvements
